Definition: from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G3563; stupidity; by implication, rage:--folly, madness.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says the folly of Jannes and Jambres shall be manifest to all, and Luke says the Pharisees were filled with madness when Jesus healed on the Sabbath. The word is senselessness turned to rage, a mind that has lost its way and lashes out.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for senseless rage holds no doctrine of its own; its picture is the Pharisees', that opposition to Jesus ends in fury without reason.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
